info.title: Class_Entry
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

comment.description: Comment to associate with the specified class entry. This column value can be empty.

count.description: Class entry attribute count action: when true, increment hit count for packets that match this Class.

dscp.description: Differentiated Services Code Point matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets. DSCP match is not supported when class type is gbp*

dst_ip.description: Destination IP matching attribute: If no IP address is specified, the Class entry will not match on destination IP address. The following IPv4 and IPv6 address formats are accepted. IPv4 format (A.B.C.D/W.X.Y.Z) IPv6 format (A:B::C:D/W:X::Y:Z) If an invalid format is used via REST, it will be accepted. Verify configurations are valid by checking for error log messages and configuration warnings in CLI. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets. Destination IP match is not supported when class type is gbp*

dst_l4_port_max.description: Maximum IP destination port matching attribute: Used in  conjunction with dst_l4_port_min and dst_l4_port_range_reverse. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

dst_l4_port_min.description: Minimum IP destination port matching attribute: Used in conjunction with dst_l4_port_max and dst_l4_port_range_reverse. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

dst_mac.description: Destination MAC matching attribute:  AAAA.BBBB.CCCC/XXXX.YYYY.ZZZZ If an invalid format is used via REST, it will be accepted. Verify configurations are valid by checking for error log messages and configuration warnings in CLI. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets. Destination MAC match is not supported when class type is gbp*

dst_role.description: Destination role matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

ecn.description: Explicit Congestion Notification matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets. Explicit Congestion match is not supported when class type is gbp*

ethertype.description: Ethernet type matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

fragment.description: Fragment matching attribute. If not specified, the class entry will not restrict matching to fragmented packets.

icmp_code.description: ICMP code matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

icmp_type.description: ICMP type matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

ip_precedence.description: IP Precedence matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets. IP Precedence match is not supported when class type is gbp*

origin.description: Origin of the class-entry, i.e., how the class-entry is provisioned.  `dynamic`:     class entry is provisioned dynamically via DUR                 from Clearpass server or via a NAS-Filter-Rule                 attribute from a RADIUS server.  `synthesized`: class entry has been dynamically synthesized                 by the system.  `static`:      class entry is provisioned by the administrator                 via CLI or REST.

pcp.description: Priority Code Point matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets. PCP match is not supported when class type is gbp*

protocol.description: IPv4 protocol matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

sequence_number.description:
Reference Resource: [Class_Entry](#/Class_Entry)
Class entries as configured by the user. An empty column value indicates that no match criteria is specified for this list.

src_ip.description: Source IP matching attribute: If no IP address is specified, the Class entry will not match on source IP address. The following IPv4 and IPv6 address formats are accepted. IPv4 format (A.B.C.D/W.X.Y.Z) IPv6 format (A:B::C:D/W:X::Y:Z) If an invalid format is used via REST, it will be accepted. Verify configurations are valid by checking for error log messages and configuration warnings in CLI. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets. Source IP match is not supported when class type is gbp*

src_l4_port_max.description: Maximum L4 port to match on the packet. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

src_l4_port_min.description: Minimum L4 port to match on the packet. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

src_mac.description: Source MAC matching attribute:  AAAA.BBBB.CCCC/XXXX.YYYY.ZZZZ If an invalid format is used via REST, it will be accepted. Verify configurations are valid by checking for error log messages and configuration warnings in CLI. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets. Source MAC match is not supported when class type is gbp*

src_role.description: Source role matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

tcp_established.description: Match packets that are in an established state, (ACK or RST flag  is set).  If not specified, the class entry will not restrict matching to established TCP connections.

tos.description: IP Type of Service value matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets. IP Type of Service match is not supported when class type is gbp*

ttl.description: Time-to-live matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

type.description: Type of a class entry: 'match':  corresponding policy actions will be performed on           the matching packets. 'ignore': matching packets will be processed as if           no policy was applied. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets.

vlan.description: VLAN-ID matching attribute. An empty column value indicates that this qualifier will not be used to match packets. VLAN-ID match is not supported when class type is gbp*

parameters.description:

parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
